mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (manuscript_id, user_id, content, like_count, reply_count, created_at, updated_at, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{manuscriptId}, #{userId}, #{content}, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW(), #{targetType}, #{targetId})
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET like_count = like_count + #{count}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comments SET like_count = #{count}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comments SET reply_count = reply_count + #{count}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE manuscript_id = #{manuscriptId}
